key: Three several places of his birth they honour, in mid-air, in the heaven, and in the waters. Governing in the east of earthly regions, the seasons hath he stablished in their order.
s: Early in a hymn to Agni as a newborn infant, the verse counts his births; Sāyaṇa, on 1.95.3, reads them as the fire beneath the ocean, the sun in heaven and the lightning, taking ‘the waters’ as a name for mid-air.
src: Sāyaṇa, Vedārthaprakāśa on Rig Veda 1.95.3, sa.wikisource (printed edition not named), revision 333253 (2022)

evidence.words: अस्याग्नेस्त्रीणि जन्मानि संभवन्ति । "समुद्रे अब्धौ वडवानलरूपेण “एकं जन्म । “दिवि द्युलोके आदित्यात्मना “एकम् । "अप्सु । आपः इति अन्तरिक्षनाम । अन्तरिक्षे वैद्युताग्निरूपेणैकम् ।
evidence.gloss: This Agni has three births: in the ocean, one birth, in the form of the submarine (mare’s) fire; in heaven, one, as the sun; in the waters: āpaḥ is a name of mid-air, so in mid-air, one, in the form of the lightning fire.
evidence.licence: public domain text; transcription CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikisource)
